composer

components · 0.4.1 · E1 · aj-c-composer

The composer: sticky at the foot of Today, never on any other screen. A row holding the field and exactly one filled control, the record control (mic part) while the field is empty and send while it holds words; below it the tools row with the keep-out-of-memory option and More options. The Today composer (the one with the option) rises 64px when the app opens and, where scroll timelines exist, tucks the same 64px while the journal is read; focus inside brings it back up. On the website's Today it is the writing companion, with the recent overview above the row. v4 C2: Ask's chat form, at the foot of Ask.
